edit.description: the committing line's two arms and the no-commit footprint subject, beside the two no-commit cases that already drive a real rewrite

summary: The ledger rewrite's two committing lines and the no-commit footprint subject are read by no test, so a swapped arm reports a footprint-only wave as shipped, green

per.section: A seam gate reads what the real writer wrote

acceptance: every operator line the merge stage renders for a ledger rewrite is driven from a real `commitPendingUpdate` call over a real repository and asserted whole — the ship-commit and footprint-commit arms of the committing line, and the `footprints for` subject the no-commit lines compose for a wave that shipped nothing — so no arm can be read into the other without a red; the tip-claim warn line, `src/waveMerge.ts` and every export are unchanged
pins: a ledger rewrite that commits a wave's shipped entries reports that commit to the operator as a ship commit
a ledger rewrite that commits a footprint-only wave reports that commit to the operator as a footprint commit
a footprint-only wave whose ledger rewrite wrote no commit names its footprints in the operator's line
notes: Off note THE-NO-COMMIT-OPERATOR-LINES-READ-A-REAL-REWRITES-EXIT.
